findings.problem: The example uses the formal usted command (Deténgase, No puede), not the informal tú register the app requires.
findings.fix: example.es: El guardia detiene los coches en la entrada.

findings.problem: The example uses reflexive detenerse (to stop oneself) in the usted form, not detener meaning to halt someone or something, as the hint says.
findings.fix: example.es: El guardia detiene los coches en la entrada. / example.en: The guard stops the cars at the entrance.

back.es: to stop, to halt (someone or something); also to arrest, to detain
back.example: Stop (yourself)! You can't go through. (formal usted command of the reflexive detenerse)

note: The trick's "detain her" leans toward the sibling "to arrest" card, but it still fits "stop" well enough.
